results.title: 10 simultaneous code requests for one address
results.expected: Exactly 1 code sent; the other 9 refused (60 s wait)
results.observed: codes sent per trial: Counter({1: 4, 4: 1, 2: 1, 6: 1, 10: 1, 8: 1, 5: 1}); accepted per trial: Counter({1: 4, 4: 1, 2: 1, 6: 1, 10: 1, 8: 1, 5: 1})
results.note: Each extra code is another email to the same inbox.

results.title: 20 simultaneous wrong guesses on one sign-in code
results.expected: At most 5 guesses counted; the code is then locked
results.observed: attempts recorded: Counter({5: 10}); right code accepted afterwards: 0 of 10

results.title: The correct code submitted 5 times at once
results.expected: Exactly 1 sign-in; the code is single-use

results.title: Two guards receive the same item at the same moment
results.expected: One succeeds; one RECEIVED entry in the history
results.observed: successful receives per trial: Counter({2: 9, 1: 1}); RECEIVED entries per item: Counter({2: 9, 1: 1})
results.note: A second entry would record two guards and two offices for one hand-in.

results.title: One student sends the same claim 5 times at once
results.expected: 1 claim created; the rest refused with 409, no server errors
results.observed: claims created per item: Counter({1: 10}); responses: {500: 28, 201: 10, 409: 12}
results.note: The database index guarantees one open claim; the question is how the duplicates are answered.

results.title: Two guards approve two different claims on one item at once
One guard approves while another rejects the same claim
results.note: Two decisions mean the history shows both, the claimant may get both emails, and the final status is whichever wrote last.

results.title: Two guards hand over the same item at once
results.expected: One hand-over: 1 COLLECTED and 1 RETURNED entry
results.observed: COLLECTED entries: Counter({2: 10}); RETURNED entries: Counter({2: 10})

results.title: Claimant withdraws at the moment a guard hands the item over
results.expected: Either returned (claim collected) or still held (claim withdrawn), never a mix

results.title: 6 photos uploaded at once to an item limited to 3
Two guards move the same item to different offices at once
results.expected: The item's office matches its newest history entry
results.observed: items whose office disagrees with the history: 0 of 10

results.title: 5 copies of the worker send drop-off reminders at the same moment
results.observed: reminder emails logged: 10; items marked reminded: 10
results.note: Uses FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED, so each worker takes different rows.

results.title: 30 reports at once, AI queue served by 3 runners (API + 2 workers)
results.expected: Every job done exactly once; no duplicate suggestions
results.observed: 30 reports: Counter({201: 30}); jobs: {'done': 30}; jobs run more than once: 0; duplicate suggestions: 0
